Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: Chinese scientific educational framework poster for a research development plan.
Create one polished high-resolution landscape 3:2 diagram, white/off-white background, clear large Chinese sans-serif labels, dark navy typography, teal observation modules, blue recurrent modules, amber candidate discovery, coral refutation, violet provenance, generous spacing and crisp arrows. Flat vector-like scientific illustration rendered as a bitmap, with small concrete visual examples, not just a wall of boxes. No photorealism. This is a PROPOSED FINAL ARCHITECTURE, not accomplished results.
Exact title: "N02 新版 RAW 编码器"
Exact subtitle: "最终目标架构 · P0—P5 分阶段建设 · 尚待实现与验证"
Main picture: left-to-right forward path with a spacious lower feedback loop.
Left: a small stack of noisy single-channel sensor measurements labelled "RAW 序列 + 标定"; an evidence ledger icon labelled "唯一测量账本" and small note "同一测量只计一次". Do not show colorful RGB reconstructions. A P0 gray foundation ribbon across top/bottom says "P0 数据划分 · 来源复现 · 数值检查" (P0 supports the whole diagram, not a network layer).
Forward row:
1. P1 badge, "观测编码与测量模型", "ConvNeXt V2-Base", "RAW 预训练 · 多尺度特征"; show noisy measurement becoming stacked feature maps, not RGB pictures.
2. P2 badge, "循环实体状态", "SAVi 预测—校正"; show three colored geometric object slots and a small time arrow h(t−1) → h(t).
3. P3 badge, "多个完整世界解释", "SMC / 结构提议"; show three separate little hypothesis cards, one fused object versus two split objects, entire alternative scenes, not independent patches averaged together. Small text "出生 · 拆分 · 合并 · 重关联".
4. P2 badge, "候选内约束求解", "Theseus"; show an energy bowl/constraint icon; text "几何 · 动态 · 测量". This feeds a prominent "测量能否解释？" node in lower center.
The measurement-check node receives BOTH actual raw measurements via a thin path from ledger and predicted RAW via a clearly marked branch from candidate state labelled "RAW 条件预测". In the check panel show two separate lines "相对评分：谁更好？" and "绝对检查：是否都错？", and small text "先解释曝光、噪声与配准". Do not equate any residual with semantic refutation.
Three outgoing outcomes from the check: green solid arrow "可接受" to right-hand final output "自洽世界状态 → 策略读出"; gray short arrow "证据不足" to small "保持歧义 / 暂缓"; coral arrow "结构不足" into a lower row revision loop.
Lower loop: P3 "提出新解释" with fused block splitting into two; then P4 "学习关系 G", "dNRI" shown as object interaction graph; adjacent P4 "推断来源 J" shown as separate provenance DAG, NOT the same graph as G; then P4 "撤回失效支持", "重建受影响状态" with a crossed-out wrong three-node chain and an independent green support branch preserved. Show versioned recurrent state rebuilt, not mathematically subtracting a hidden state.
A prominent curved feedback arrow from revision back to complete world hypotheses, labelled "同一测量集合上再求解". The loop needs constrained acceptance and checking, not automatically accept every proposal. Small note "有独立支持的判断保留，受影响数值仍需重算".
An encompassing pale dashed bracket labelled "P5 集成与理论审计" encloses candidate-search, solve, check and revision loop. A small footer strip explains "P1 学会看证据   P2 持续推断   P3 发现新解释   P4 学依赖并撤回   P5 检验独有价值".
At far-right output put a small connector "接图2：P6 → π0.5".
Constraints: accurate logical arrow directions, distinct data flow versus feedback, no eight serial stages, no RGB teacher or RGB intermediate, no guaranteed real-world success, no numerical benchmark scores, don't confuse P3 and P4, never write PI05 as a convolution layer. Only the supplied short labels plus necessary minimal arrow labels; prioritize readable labels over density.
